business_summary: Zeta Inc. engages in digital marketing solutions business in Japan. The company offers ZETA SEARCH, an e-commerce product search and site search engine; ZETA AD which allows to set up ad space on various pages, such as search result pages, product detail pages, and cart pages; ZETA GEO, a solution that optimizes e-commerce sites for AI-generated searches; ZETA HASHTAG, analyzes text, including product descriptions and reviews, and extracts keywords related to the product as hashtags; ZETA VOICE that implement review content on website. It also provides ZETA ENGAGEMENT, a loyalty improvement engine; ZETA BASKET, a service that allows users and company staff to take the lead in generating content; ZETA LINK, a generative AI connectivity platform that seamlessly links AI chat with the ZETA product suite through agentic search mechanisms; ZETA CLICK, connects stores that provide experiences with EC that provides information, realizing a new consumer experience in the digital transformation era; ZETA RECOMMEND, uses artificial intelligence and machine learning to predict needs and provide personalized recommendations; ZETA TALK, an AI chat for e-commerce; ZETA SEARCH IMAGE EXTENSION, an image search engine; and ZETA DMP, a prediction and personalization solution. Zeta Inc. was formerly known as Scigineer Inc. Zeta Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
